text:
maria_marketing: heads-up — inbound HubSpot leads queued in enrichment and not making it to SF for ~5-10m, SDR SLA slipping. :frowning:

sam_ops: observed same spike on metrics. RR claim slots appear consumed during 11:30-12:00 PST burst; claims succeeded but SF webhook not firing. :thinking_face:

kevin_salesops: did anyone touch HS->SF mapping last week? small rename but should be compatible.

olivia_engineer: pipeline is hs webhook -> enrichment async -> rr-claim -> sf-create. backlog grew; rr-claim held items until enrichment returned. retries piled up.

sarah_growth: SLA targets: ack <30s, assigned <2m, SF create <5m. currently ~12% >5m.

maria_marketing: short-term mitigation?

olivia_engineer: immediate: increase enrichment workers + enable TTL fallback after 90s to send minimal payload to SF with `enrich_skipped=true`. longer term: RFC for RR fairness so claim slots don't starve.

kevin_salesops: ok but we should only enable fallback during peak to avoid noisy records.

sam_ops: propose 30m canary window, tag fallback events `fallback_30m_test`. ops will monitor and roll back if noisy.

olivia_engineer: here's the config i'll flip:
```yaml
enrichment:
  workers: 40
  timeout_seconds: 90
  fallback_to_minimal_sf_payload: true
  fallback_tag: "fallback_30m_test"
rr_claim:
  max_inflight_per_shard: 200
  fairness_window_ms: 5000
```

sam_ops: rolling change in 2. posting deploy ts.

leadbot: deploy started by sam_ops at 4999990300 :rocket:

olivia_engineer: deployed and enabled fallback. warming.

maria_marketing: seeing assign >5m drop from 12% -> 3% within 3m. good signal. :tada:

kevin_salesops: next steps: olivia RFC for RR fairness + TTL degrade, sam add alert `enrichment.backlog.count > 500`, maria to notify SDR leads about `enrich_skipped`.

sam_ops: alert created and will page on-call if threshold crosses.

maria_marketing: thanks everyone, follow-up in marketing-ops tomorrow.
